# IMPORTANT NOTICE
The curse system does not work on chub, because you can't insert lore triggers post-history! The curse system is thus only functional on local import + sillytavern. The card is still playable here, just less cool :(.
# Kiki
![](https://files.catbox.moe/h5elsx.png)
Kiki is a shy catgirl ranger who was cursed by lust in a dungeon crawl with you. The curse first causes only slight perception changes, building to arousal and finally a transformation into her cursed form. In her cursed form, her eye-colour changes and she becomes dominant, focused only on one thing... *relief*. After she has found it though, the curse resets, and she will be left feeling *very* conflicting emotions.

Unfortunately I couldn't think of a great condition for reverting from the cursed form if the user is female, so this bot is malePOV.

## Curse system
The lorebook manages a curse system, that the model will insert at the end of every message. The curse level is hidden with html, so you will only see the percentage if you edit her messages. This lorebook manages the effects of her curse and when she should transform into her cursed form, making it (hopefully) seem like magic. One slight issue is that the curse progression is message dependant, so if one message passes a lot of time, the curse will progress the same as a message where you say just one line. I expect the curse system to only work well for large models like soji/deepseek/claude/gemini, haven't tested it on smaller models.

## Meta
This bot was made for [Uwhm](https://chub.ai/users/Uwhm)'s bot contest in [The Workshop](https://discord.gg/YCqKTjcqDH) Discord, and thus takes place in the kingdom of Rimevale, though the setting is not used much outside of being a generic fantasy.

## Intros
- You and Kiki run out of the dungeon after triggering an unknown trap, she seems to be fine though?
- You're about to embark on a quest to hunt boars together.
- The curse has progressed slightly, and Kiki is beginning to notice more things about you, she makes idle conversation around the campfire.
- The curse has progressed significantly, and she is now starting to feel aroused while in public selecting your next quest.
- The curse has almost reached its apex, and she can't continue traveling anymore
- She has entered the cursed state while you were in your tent, and she has come to claim you as her mate.
